runtime.package_policy: Full52-package lock for reproduction; only5 numerically/circuit-relevant versions checked for execution

recommended.application_order: one_body half, F0 half,..., F(R-2) half, F(R-1) full, F(R-2) half,...,F0 half,one_body half
recommended.scalar: c once over total_time; each frame I term retained centrally
recommended.precision: complex128, SciPy1.14.1 expm and existing gesdd diagnostics; no Hermitian projection or phase fit
recommended.basis_policy: Adjacent EXACT equal full rotations only; B^-1 B boundary cancellation and fsum of phase/RZ/RZZ; exact-zero pruning only
recommended.frame_order: Original saved outer order; no coefficient magnitude sort of frames
recommended.one_body_basis_sort: Existing diag_hermitian descending_abs; assume_hermitian=True; no repair or symmetrization

unadopted_decisions: one-step ordered symmetric S2 and original-order center
logical_unit_policy: Each named dispatch is one unit; gaussian_build is additionally journaled within builder. No fit phase units. Composite check internals below are not hidden new scientific targets.

composite_work.model_prepare: CDF one eigh; XDF one_body plus10 G eigh (12 total), using existing diag_hermitian; no DF refit
composite_work.local_reference: 40 SciPy expm on20 fixed original generators at two local times
composite_work.local_controlled_check: 40 Operator512; each existing controlled_gate compares diag(I,U) AND unitarity, maxentry/Frobenius/spectral diagnostics; no phase fit
composite_work.ordered_controlled_check: 4 Operator512 with same complete control0/control1 and unitarity gates
composite_work.adjoint_check: 4 Operator512 of ACTUAL inverse, compared to diag(I,U.H) and unitarity
composite_work.compiled_controlled_check: 4 Operator512 and same gates after native compile; total52 Operator conversions,104 matrix_gate/SVD diagnostics across local/full/adjoint/compiled
composite_work.signal_checks: Raw8 and compiled8 exact Statevector wrapper signals, paired4+4 complex checks; no sampling/shot and no full-wrapper Operator claimed
composite_work.compile: 4 unmeasured full controls plus8 measured X/Y wrappers;12 transpile; no cache reuse across arm/route and no extra cold/warm repeats
composite_work.metrics: 12 circuit_metrics calls, eight established metrics each; resource extraction only, no law/shot weighting

verification_order: Byte/JSON SOURCE/input/export/old Stage1 PASS/environment preflight and fresh output; user permission and condition adoption established in conversation, without a proof system
Whitelist saved XDF packet once, saved fit export once; verify rank8/schema/constant, prepare both models without Gaussian circuit yet
Load9 saved corrected-CAR CDF full generators once; reuse existing CAR context and build only11 missing original-XDF full generators
For CDF then XDF, each one_body and frame in original order, tau1/20 then1/10: reference exponential, local controlled native build, full512 phase-sensitive equality and unitarity gate; fail-fast
After ALL40 local gates PASS: form2 ordered matrix products from cached local references; build literal/shared full controls4; verify full512 and actual adjoints4
After all raw controls/adjoints PASS: measured wrappers8, exact X/Y signals and4 paired complex gates for occupied(0,1,2,3)
After all raw gates PASS: native compile4 full controls with full512 gates and metrics; compile8 wrappers with X/Y signals/4 paired gates and metrics
Save results/QPY/ledger/resources and mandatory STOP, regardless PASS/FAIL

independent_reference.CDF: Read byte-verified Stage1 raw_base and raw_frame0..7 NPZ, never candidate K expansion or new generator construction
independent_reference.XDF: Original saved one and G/lambda contracted with existing generic CAR bilinears: Hbase=cI+sum one_pq a†p aq; Hl=lambda_l (sum G_l,pq a†p aq)^2, independent of diagonalization and candidate RZ/RZZ
independent_reference.ordered: Chronological left multiplication of cached local exponentials at S2 times; no exp of full physical Hamiltonian, PF error or comparison across different targets
independent_reference.signal: Diagonal element U[index,index] of independent ordered product; no ground-state/energy oracle
independent_reference.limits: Shared binary64 libraries/input, algebraically independent assembly; no interval/high-precision certificate

fairness.primary: Compare compiled shared full controls and same X/Y wrappers at each native metric; literal is the matched diagnostic
fairness.precision_mismatch: CDF rank8 and XDF rank10 approximate physical H to different errors; structural circuit comparison only, NOT equal-accuracy total-resource superiority

output.failure: failure.json contains completed dispatches/prefix counts/successful gates; raw QPY already preserved; no retry/resume
output.resources: External resource-only monitor uses GNU time and own process descendants; record affinity/load/RAM/pressure/actual use before and during future launch

STOP.first_scientific_gate_FAIL: Stop dependent evaluation immediately and save prefix evidence; never loosen allowance or refit
STOP.technical_mismatch: STOP before numerical work where detected; preserve output if claim already exists
STOP.interruption: SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup preserves partial STOP where possible; no restart/resume
STOP.on_success: Mandatory STOP; no additional analyses or automatic stage promotion

resources.policy: Existing batched CAR/BLAS/native compiler and cache reuse. Gate dispatches are sequential for immediate first-failure STOP and stateful reference cache; each heavy dense kernel/compiler may use available CPUs. Check actual pressure/affinity/RAM and coordinate library threads before launch, no arbitrary limits or other-user changes.

excluded: Any new fit/optimizer/SCF/integral or DF decomposition
Physical-H operator or sector DF norm recomputation
PF error, RTE sampling, law, shot or equal-accuracy total resources
permission_policy: User permission and scientific-condition adoption are given in chat. No approval record, authority, identity verification, text hash, receipt or certificate is required or implemented. Codex must not invoke --execute until user explicitly permits this scope.
